title: Insights → Crawler at phone width: its tables as cards, failures in plain words
why: Jason's screenshot (2026-11-23): Insights → Crawler, opened from an alarm's side panel on a phone, showed its task table cut off on the left: the table was 622px wide inside a 334px box that scrolled sideways. Below 768px each row is now a card with labelled lines (decisions/0058 §11; design/table-standard.md, phones), at 1280 it stays a table. A failure reads in words through OutsideServices::plainWhy ('503 Service Unavailable', never the server's HTML page); no 'From .' for a task with no source named; an empty queue says 'nothing waiting'.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
